title: BHOPAL 1984
sub: वो रात, जब शहर सो रहा था
en: One tank. And a sleeping city.
At the Union Carbide plant, tank 610 held 42 tonnes of poisonous gas.
That night, the pressure in the tank began to climb fast.
The unit that kept it cold had been shut down for months.
The flare tower was under repair, and the water curtain could not reach high enough.
After midnight, the gas burst out of the vent stack.
Heavier than air, it crept along the ground into sleeping homes.
No one was given any warning.
